_comment: F04#6 distinct aftermath (round-1 judge: 'aftermaths are dialogue shots with no world change'). Per named Meadows trainer, what the world visibly does once they are beaten. Read by scripts/world/trainer_aftermath.gd; derived entirely from the trainer's existing world-scoped defeat flag, so every peer and every reload converges on the same state with no new durable data. `standard`: Team Tether's installed oxblood Banner_1 standard (props.json's own MEADOWS-VERTICAL-STANDARDS values) planted beside the captain at `offset` [right, forward] metres in the captain's own frame (bodies face +Z), no collider; beaten, its colours are struck: the oxblood cloth fades off the frame and the bare post is left (a tipped Banner_1 is a gallows shape hanging in the air, not a fallen flag -- local preview 2026-09-28). `stand_down`: after the defeat slump the captain walks to `offset` and turns `turn_deg` from their fighting facing (until the player comes within notice range, when the body turns to them as every NPC does) -- out of the road, no longer barring it. `victory_show`: what the trainer hands over, shown in the air between them and the player while the victory lines run (the Warden's Realm Key and Heart of the Meadows; each captain's Sigil in its item colour), then carried to the player. ALL TUNABLE.
_why_timing_f04_6_r5: Judge r5 (aftermath_r5): Vance's and Vess's standards were already translucent by the first frame of their lines, Dell's step-aside happened after the camera had left him, and no token was ever seen moving to the player. The strike now starts `strike_after_lines_open_s` into the victory lines and takes `strike_seconds`; the trainer steps aside, and the tokens are handed over `handover_after_last_line_s` after, as the LAST line is presented (dialogue_panel line_presented is_last) -- all inside the victory shot. TUNABLE.

site_object._why: WORLD River Lock: 'Victory frees the captive'. A Tether holding cage, chained shut beside Vance; beaten, the cage lies tipped open on its side and its chain is thrown off on the ground.

pieces._why: Probes pa1/pa2: the kit cage stands upright at roll 0 (the captive's cage); rolled 90 and lifted it lies tipped on its side, open, after the win.

sigil_stone._why_r8_bright: F04#6 r8 judge: the lit sigil was not readable through the HUD; bigger emblem and a stronger light.

site_object._why: Oreth (patience, the river path): a Tether checkpoint barrier of two fence sections across the path with a barrel; beaten, the barrier is dismantled, the sections stacked flat at the verge and the barrel rolled aside, the path open.

sigil_stone._why_r8_bright: F04#6 r8 judge: the lit sigil was not readable through the HUD; bigger emblem and a stronger light.

site_object._why: Halder (range control, the field): a Tether watch-fire with two signal torches; beaten, the fire is cold logs (the same bonfire without its flames) and the torches lie lowered on the ground.

pieces._why: probe pa2: at 2.2 the kenney stone ring was too flat to read; 4.0 is a 2 m ring that stays as the cold pit.

sigil_stone._why_r8_bright: F04#6 r8 judge: the lit sigil was not readable through the HUD; bigger emblem and a stronger light.

site_object._why: Vess (endurance, Ridgeline Watch): the lookout's Tether rope line strung between two posts with a lit lantern; beaten, the line is cut down, the ropes lie on the ground, one post is toppled and the lantern is out.

relay_officer_dell._why: F04#6 (judge r3 3b6f965a): the relay officer's win changed nothing in frame. Beaten at his own post, Dell steps aside from it, as his lines say, toward the captain's console; Vance's own change is the struck standard.

site_object._why: WORLD River Lock: the relay picket. Dell's Tether pylon hums lit (live finish, cyan light) while he holds the post; beaten, it goes dark (the installed dead finish), lists, and its cable lies slack on the ground.

trainers._why_victory_show_f04_6_r4: Judge r4 (7121d40c): a captain's medallion hung at face height between lens and captain read as an interact marker over the face, and the Warden's heart read as a pale blob. The tokens are now held out at chest height beside the speaker (side_m along their shoulder line), each Sigil carries its own emblem (river waves, field chevrons, ridge peak) at 1.35x, and the Heart is 1.6x. Aftermath render af2 (03e7486c): the three-sphere heart still read as a pale cloud and 0.8 m aside still covered the Warden's chest, so the Heart is now the classic square-and-two-lobes shape in leaf green, held 1.25 m aside.

_why_f04_6_r6: Judge r6 (captures 2026-10-11): the faded cloth on the bare frame read as a translucent slab on a gallows, the floating Sigil as a HUD token, Dell left no change. Now: the standard is pulled down (sinks `fall_sink_m` over `strike_seconds`) and its installed Banner_1_Cloth lands flat and opaque at its foot (`fallen_cloth`); each captain's Sigil is still handed over during the lines and is now also carved on a standing stone at their post (`sigil_stone`, dark until beaten, then lit); each captain's site gets one touch of installed props after the win (`touch`: Oreth's river watch fire doused and a beached log, Halder's field camp packed, a cairn raised on Vess's ridge); Dell's post at the relay gate gets the same standard. ALL TUNABLE.
_why_f04_6_r6b: Aftermath render r6 (f36f1b7f): the nature-kit rock_tallA read as a small pale lump; the Sigil stones and Vess's cairn use the stylized_nature Rock_Medium family the Meadows already uses around the Warrens.
_why_f04_6_r8_no_cloth: F04#6 r8 code-blind judge: the fallen-cloth scraps read as flat untextured red polygons. Removed; the standard still sinks out of sight (fall_sink_m). Each fight now has its own site_object instead of a shared template.
